title: A Tizenkét Pont (The Twelve Points)
grammar: Political Declarations, Subjunctive Demands & 1848 Narrative Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Twelve Points demanded.
I can say what the crowd demanded using Kívánjuk, hogy and a subjunctive verb.
I can say what the authorities in Buda agreed to.
I can use six new words about the Twelve Points, such as nemzetőrség and jobbágyfelszabadítás.
